scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 62 km. 1172 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Col des Gets → Col des Aravis
scenicChapters.narrative: 79 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1967 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Col de l Iseran → Col du Galibier
scenicChapters.narrative: Exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it. Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2764 m for 139 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley.

route-des-grandes-alpes-thonon-les-bains.story: 430 km from Thonon-les-Bains to Valloire, about 6 h 02 of riding. It goes by way of Col des Gets, Col des Aravis, Col du Cormet de Roselend and Col de l Iseran. The highest point is about 2,750 m. Cormet de Roselend and Col du Galibier are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Giau · Dolomites
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 26 km this is Great Dolomites Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-the-dolomites-sciliar-catinaccio.story: From Cortina d'Ampezzo it runs 157 km to Cortina d'Ampezzo; allow about 2 h 42 of riding. The stops in between: Pelmo-Croda da Lago, Marmolada, Sciliar-Catinaccio and back through Marmolada. The highest point is about 1,950 m. The line favours views over speed.
